types.DecodedExecution: mode typed-execute | composition-step | composition-run plus the matching payload
types.CodecResult: ok DecodedIR | malformed DecodeFailure | blocked ResourceLimit
types.Outcome: codec CodecResult | execution Report | audit AuditResult
types.JudgmentOutcome: true | false | notReached | notApplicable; never outstanding or accepted
types.JudgmentResult: family; outcome; claimed : Bool; match : Bool
types.outstanding: separate list of informational names; not a JudgmentOutcome constructor
types.ExecutionResultEnc: world state+store; this is the claimed_next_state layer, not StateEnc
types.RawObservation: world; receipt; outputs; events; nextIndex; cursorFailure; kernelFailure. Not a Report.

checkBytes_contract: malformed/blocked never call Typed.execute or Composition.executeStep/run
claimed_next_state compared as ExecutionResultEnc after recomputation; mismatch observationMismatch
source_identity mismatch: checkIR is staleSource, rawExecute is not the report projection, Typed.execute is not called
rawExecute never consults source_identity, six-class presence, claimed_next_state, or require_*_discharge
